addressForm: Singular wewe with singular imperatives and -ako possessives, for operators and customers alike: CRDB Bank (Swahili merchant page) “Kuza biashara yako”, “Tengeneza tu msimbo wa QR na uonyeshe kwa wateja”, “Unaweza kutembelea tawi … nawe”; Uber Eats TZ (sw) “Agiza mapema”, “chagua mgahawa”, “Jisajili bila malipo”, “Anza sasa”. confidence: Med — address form (singular wewe), oda / agiza mapema / kuchukua oda / menyu / mgahawa / POS / simu ya mkononi are confirmed on Tanzanian Swahili pages (Uber Eats TZ, CRDB); the food-truck word is Low (only Jiji’s category “Malori ya Chakula”; no Tanzanian food-truck business page found), and the Pay at Hatch wording, plan names, combo and walk-up terms rest on general Tanzanian usage. csvRows are the WebSearch (US-indexed) results for “mfumo wa oda za chakula kwa migahawa na food truck Tanzania”, not local Google ranks; no ordering-system vendor writes in Swahili in that SERP, so the Swahili keyword space is open.
decisions: Food-truck word: recommend the loanword “food truck” (class 9/10 agreement: food truck yako, food truck zako) with “gari la chakula / magari ya chakula” on first mention and as a secondary keyword. Avoid “lori la chakula” as the main word: Jiji uses “Malori ya Chakula” for vehicles for sale, and lori suggests a big lorry.

Pay at Hatch: recommend feature “Lipa Unapochukua” / short “Lipa ukichukua”. Avoid “Lipa unapopokea / malipo wakati wa kupokea” (cash on delivery) and do not reuse “Lipa Namba” (an M-Pesa / Lipa kwa Simu merchant till number, a different thing).

Payments: Tanzanian customers pay mostly with mobile money (M-Pesa, Mixx by Yas, Airtel Money via Lipa kwa Simu), cards less so — card-only online payment means Pay at the truck will be the main path in TZ.
Plans: “kifurushi / vifurushi” (the telecom word for a paid bundle) used for plan; “Pro” stays; “Lipa kadri unavyotumia” for Pay as you go — a native check is advised.
Kenyan readers understand this Tanzanian copy; do not mix Kenyan forms (rununu, Lipa na M-Pesa, Till Number, Sheng).
